Through great effort, a previous research scientist manually stumbled upon the correct frequencies for Crystal 1, Crystal 2, and Crystal 3, which are in their respective reactors. Your task is to use science to figure out the correct frequency for Crystal 4 and Crystal 5, set their reactors to the appropriate frequency, and install the crystals. Once all four crystals are installed, the reactor will be able to generate a great deal of power. To support your task, a number of scientific instruments are available in the lab.
